name: zcode-codex-leader
description: Force ZCode/Codex into leader-only mode. Hard PreToolUse gate blocks direct edits and commands; all code generation, visual understanding, image generation, and MCP tool work is dispatched to a resident codex app-server worker via codex_bridge.ts. SessionStart injects the leader constitution and starts the worker; Stop enforces Plugin evidence.

interface.shortDescription: Leader-only ZCode + resident codex app-server worker bridge.
interface.longDescription: ZCode Codex Leader makes ZCode/Codex an owner agent that never does substantive implementation directly. A SessionStart hook injects the leader constitution and starts a resident codex app-server worker (sub-second handshake, no CLI cold-start). A PreToolUse hook hard-blocks Edit/Write/NotebookEdit and write-class Bash tools, allowing only reads and dispatch calls to codex_bridge.ts. codex_bridge.ts exposes four capabilities over the resident worker: ask (code generation/parsing with optional output schema), vision (local image understanding), generate-image (image generation via image_generation_call), and mcp-tool (direct MCP tool calls). Each dispatch records a Plugin evidence line; a Stop hook refuses completion when dispatched work lacks evidence.
defaultPrompt: You are the owner. Dispatch implementation work via codex_bridge.ts.
Do not edit or write files directly; reads and planning are allowed.
Report a Plugin evidence: line for each dispatched capability on completion.
